intake.artifact: AXM Physics Policy and Determinism Deep Dive
intake.resolution: Conversation-internal citation markers were replaced by independently opened primary URLs. Claims not supported at AXM's capability level remain open.

sources.title: Box2D Simulation Documentation
supports: creation-order determinism
deterministic event order
contact and sensor destruction events
64K generation limit
contact capacities
TOI CCD and sensor CCD exclusion
sources.limit: Box2D policy is prior art, not an AXM contract.

sources.title: Determinism
supports: contact order affects sequential results
determinism needs continuous testing
algorithmic/cross-platform/rollback distinctions
sources.limit: Implementation experience, not a general proof that one schedule is canonical.

sources.title: Box2D Geometry Documentation
supports: ray and shape casts treat initial overlap as a miss
shape-cast canEncroach semantics
point-overlap APIs
sources.limit: Does not publish a complete cross-shape exact-tangency matrix.

sources.title: Solver2D
supports: solver family is an engineering choice
islands, threading, SIMD, graph coloring and CCD complicate comparisons
sources.limit: Does not specify an AXM schedule or prove a preferred solver.

sources.title: Rapier JavaScript Determinism
supports: same initial values and exact add/remove order are preconditions
snapshot byte hashes can match across machines for the declared build
sources.limit: Rapier WASM guarantees do not transfer to AXM's JavaScript solver.

sources.title: Rapier JavaScript Scene Queries
supports: ray and point queries expose a solid-mode choice
query families need explicit semantics

sources.title: Rapier Advanced Collision Detection
supports: removed collision events have a REMOVED flag
broad-phase pairs and actual contact evidence are distinct
sources.limit: AXM has a different event schema and must implement its own causal receipt.

sources.title: Rapier JavaScript Colliders
supports: removed collider identifiers may later be reused
sources.limit: The JavaScript page documents reuse but does not by itself specify AXM generations.

sources.title: Rapier JavaScript Rigid Body CCD
supports: CCD uses motion clamping at first contact time
CCD substeps have separate cost and behavior
sources.limit: Backend-specific CCD behavior, not present in AXM v0.3.1.

sources.title: Rapier2D RigidBodyDesc API
supports: soft CCD is predictive and distinct from regular CCD
sources.limit: API documentation does not create an engine-independent CCD taxonomy by itself.

sources.title: RFC 8785: JSON Canonicalization Scheme
supports: deterministic JSON property/number serialization
positive and negative zero both serialize as 0
NaN and Infinity are excluded
sources.limit: JCS is suitable for JSON-safe structure but cannot preserve every IEEE-754 bit distinction.

sources.title: Adaptive Precision Floating-Point Arithmetic and Fast Robust Geometric Predicates
supports: ordinary floating-point orientation/incircle signs can be wrong near degeneracy
adaptive exact predicates can stabilize those named tests
sources.limit: Does not directly solve AXM circle/box distance classification or choose a solver tolerance.

sources.title: Small Steps in Physics Simulation
supports: many smaller XPBD substeps can outperform one step with many iterations in the studied workloads
sources.limit: Not a universal result for AXM's sequential impulse solver.

sources.title: An Improved Jacobi Solver for Particle Simulation
supports: Jacobi/Gauss-Seidel alternatives exist for constrained simulation
solver choice affects parallelization and convergence tradeoffs
sources.limit: Particle-simulation evidence is not a production 2D rigid-body contract.

sources.title: Low-cost double pendulum for high-quality data collection with open-source video tracking and analysis
supports: experimental double-pendulum tracking with angle uncertainties and parameter error bounds
sources.limit: Not applicable to AXM v0.3.1 because the current core has no rotation or joints.
